create_replay_buffer: create a ReplayBuffer instance with a Storage and Sampler for experience replay
append_transitions: append transition data to the replay buffer with an optional priority value
sample_batch: sample a batch of transitions from the replay buffer with or without replacement
extend_buffer: extend the replay buffer with a sequence of transitions and their priorities
warm_up_remote_buffer: warm up a RemoteReplayBuffer by waiting until it reaches the target size
